cases.name: Tamara Lynn Pindar Pittao
cases.narrative:
On 11/27/1997, her body was found in her apartment in her toddler daughter's bedroom. Kanu Virani, a medical examiner for Oakland County, determined she died on the afternoon of Nov. 24 from head and neck trauma caused by a blunt object. “She was struck on the head, smothered, and then the throat was slashed,” he said.. A pathologist's report concluded that she likely died three days earlier.

cases.name: Patrice Latoya Wilson
cases.about:
She was a nurse at Detroit Medical Center. “It is with deep sadness that we offer heartfelt condolences to the family, friends and DMC colleagues of cherished nurse leader Patrice Wilson, as well as Patrice’s mother, another dedicated DMC team member. Patrice was not just a co-worker but a loving friend to many at the DMC. Grief counseling is available for all staff at our Adult Central Campus hospitals.”

Detroit Medical Center
cases.narrative: After lurking outside the hospital where she worked for hours while wearing a disguise of a blond wig, hat and mask, he allegedly abducted her at approximately 7:40 a.m. in the 4200 block of St. Antoine Street in Detroit, MI as she was leaving work after an overnight shift at Detroit Receiving Hospital. He approached her just as she was getting into the driver’s side of her vehicle, got inside the vehicle and forced her over and fled with her inside.Her body was found in the trunk of her SUV at an apartment complex in the city of Novi, Michigan, off Haggerty Road between 9 and 10 Mile roads.
